title: SOTA source registry
description: Contract for the SOURCES_START/END block in docs/internal/PRODUCT/SOURCES.md. A source is admitted as evidence only when its quotations can be checked against a committed excerpt — a URL in a document proves nothing, because the page can change or can never have said it. Enforced by scripts/check-sources.mjs (INV-147, #2480).

url.description: Recorded provenance, never dereferenced by the tier-1 gate. A gate that fails when a website is down fails for a reason unrelated to the claim it guards.

retrieved_at.description: When the excerpt was taken. A source has an age, and the web moves under citations.

excerpt_path.description: Committed, citation-length excerpt. Short by design: enough to check the quotations this project makes, never a reproduction of the source.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the excerpt file. Without it, a substring check would still pass on an excerpt edited after the fact — the evidence could drift away from what was actually read.

citations.description: A source nobody quotes is a bookmark, not evidence. Each quoted_text must appear verbatim in the excerpt.

selected_by_user.description: Whether a human chose this source from a shortlist. An agent-selected source is a candidate; adoption is a human act, and the field records which happened rather than blurring the two.

informs.description: The ADR / INV ids this source bears on. Empty means cited but not yet applied to any decision — visible rather than implied.

application_status.description: The ladder. `applied-certified` is the only rung claiming the source demonstrably shaped the architecture, and tier 3 (graph reachability) is what will admit it — tier 1 records the claim but does not adjudicate it.
